Extract L294-295 reads in full: '-Bybee, J. (2004). "A Usage-Based Model for Phonology and Morphology". En: Phonology and Language Use.' — no publisher, no place, no imprint of any kind. The node's own frame states the rule as «se dibujan como libro ÚNICAMENTE los volúmenes citados con pie de imprenta», and the exit name itself admits «el programa no consigna pie de imprenta». The node therefore violates its own declared selection criterion, self-disclosed. Either the rule should be restated (e.g. 'volúmenes monográficos, con o sin pie de imprenta') or Bybee should not be drawn.
